nom: COSRX The AHA BHA PHA LHA 35 Peel with Vitamins B5 & B12

avis.texte: Like other comments, theres something wrong with the way the company seal the top of the bottle- when you squeeze tube its not even coming out where it should it leaks from the top of bottle! Ive used 2x and the bottle is almost gone due to this. Unfortunately i tried it past the 30 day return window so I just essentially wasted my $. However the peel does seem to work good. Not sure ill repurchase til the brand fixes this issue

avis.titre: Packaging breaks and leaks, impossible to use
avis.texte: Came damaged, got it replaced and the tube broke at the top again and product leaked. The tube is not suitable for acid I guess. Would buy in better packaging, the peel itself is great.

I have combo, sensitive skin with a lot of texture on my chin that I've been trying to minimize. Using this has been great for my skin care, I use it maybe twice a month and only for about eight minutes at a time. I put it on my chin and wait a couple of seconds before putting the rest on my face. I do find that I have baby smooth skin after using and the next day. I did takeoff half a star because every time I would squeeze the bottle, there would be some product leaking out. I just realized that the product was leaking from a split in the top where it should be sealed so I am losing a lot of product. Thankfully its not too expensive. I would definitely buy again!

avis.titre: Mild AHA-PHA for my vitc-retial routine
avis.texte: I was looking for cheaper option for weekly AHA-BHA than paula's. This is good for my skin, it has been 4 weeks since I apply once a week.

I just receive this peel. I put on my nose has blackheads for 10 mins then wipe it off with lukrwarm water. First few second u felt tingling. It is a small tube. I think kinda expensive . Next time I will put on my face .

Amazinggggggg! I have acne prone skin and very large pores and this product has dimnished both! My skin is smoother, clearer, softer. Even helped my closed comodones shrink and smoothen out! There was mild tingling, and my skin did break out/purge, but that only lasted 3 days. I've only used this product once a week and im on week 2. Will for sure continue using this product!

I have so much trouble clearing my dark spots and after about 3 times using it (1 time once a week), my dark spots had significantly faded. I would also put this on growing pimples and the next day it would be 60% gone, less red, and less painful! Its also pretty gentle and I have rosacea and sensitive skin. Definitely use for only 10 mins, if you're really sensitive try 7-8mins!

I could tell that the product I received had been returned and resold which I'm okay with in this case since there's not a dropper with this container ( a lot of people drag those across their face) but a little under half of the container was gone… I did get it with a few dollars off on sale but oh my gosh. I would hate to reorder full price and get the same thing… the product itself is actually pretty gentle even with the higher level of acids. I didn't start off with 10 mins kinda worked my way up starting with 3 mins and only a little product to see how my skin would react. No irritation so far! I would probably order directly from cosrx from now on though and no more dropper things from here 😅

I absolutely adore this product! It effectively resets my skin, allowing my moisturizer to penetrate deeply, resulting in a radiant and glowing complexion. I was skeptical until I witnessed the remarkable results on my own skin - love! Just a brown woman in her 40s, shining bright and loving life!

This is literally my first review on Ulta and I'm writing to say how much i love this product. I have hormonal acne and constently break out around my mouth. I've been using this product once a week for a month now and i haven't broken out!! My skin is smoother, brighter and my acne scars are fading. I only wish the tube was bigger because I am for sure going to be using this regularly.
I have sensitive aging skin. This definitely helped the appearance of my skin. The first use diminished discoloration and improved some fine lines. It definitely improved dryness.
The first time I used this product I noticed my skin appeared smoother and felt softer immediately. Works on my sensitive skin without issues.

I love COSRx and have tried quite a few products from them. I do have regularly scheduled monthly facials/exfoliations for my combo skin, however, I wanted to give this a try for days when I needed a little more TLC. My acne is more hormonal and I tend to get more under the skin acne on my jawline. My cheeks tend to get one occasional under the skin bump or traditonal small white head zit. I had read about this product before but was really scared to try because of the "tingling" sensation. My first use of the product felt so irritating that I could not keep it on for the full 10 mins. But I did notice that throughout the week, my stubborn bumps on my jawline lessened. I gave it a go a second time a week later, and I have to say that this product does an amazing job. The second time was not as harsh and much easier to get to 10mins. I already see a better appreance on my cheeks and jawline. This is only twice that I have used this product, but I am happy I took the plunge. I feel it helps to clean up any dead skin cells that continue to clog my pores. My skin has not been this clear in a long time. I would say to definitely use caution on the first time if you have bery sensitive skin.
Feels amazing, warm tingled a bit but that goes away my skin looks soft and feels sexy
This is the ONLY product I've tried so far that has cleared up a lot of the sebaceous filaments on my nose. I highly recommend if you struggle with that!

I've been exploring this brand recently and came across this one. Had good reviews so I got it, used it right after a shower and rinsed with lukewarm water, loved how it left my skin feeling. I will use this again and would recommend.

avis.titre: Easy to use at home peel
avis.texte: I love this peel. It gives a nice glass skin finish. The prickly sensation wasn't too bad but I would not suggest it for someone who is new to exfoliating.
Really makes a difference to minimize breakouts and reduce look of pores. Face feels great.
Tried twice loved it every time waiting to use more to see the results will update later.
I've only used this product once. You can feel it tingling. The smell is mild and it leaves your skin looking amazing.
My skin felt amazing after using this. My pore size appear smaller.
It tingles a little but overall a great product, skin is smooth and glowing. pores have shrunk

Not as aggressive as I was hoping, but pretty good, regardless. I would like one just a little stronger to really help clear out congested pores and help the skin cells turn over quicker. I've been using acids for years, so this strength might be better for a beginner?
first time to use and it has sting sensation. my skin appears some patches in red so it's a bit concerning. i washed it off after 5 mins. overall it's not bad but maybe too strong for my skin type
I use this once a week and it really helps to get the congestion out of my pores. The smell is not bad unless you're very sensitive to smells.
I was worried it would burn my skin but it was fine. Light texture. My skin glowed after.
Honestly I havent use it but heard good reviews. Propbably gonna use it tonight.
I used this product and my skin was tingling a bit. After I rinse it off my pores looked great. I love this product.
Very effective! Made my face smoother and cleared pores. Might not be for everyone though
doesn't smell the prettiest, but it works! after one use my skin felt softer, looked more vibrant, and my acne looked so much better the following morning. very pleased!

I've only used it 2 weeks so far but I love how bright my skin on my face looks after use. only time will tell if it helps with texture also! it does tingle while it's on my face, but I like the feeling lol. and it's pink!
Literally the morning after my first use of this my skin feels so soft! it's crazy how fast I could see a difference - hopefully this is a long term solution to rough/textured issue
So far so good. I only used it twice so far. Only difference I've noticed so far is my skin peeling a little. Thank goodness no major breakouts from using the product.

I am shocked at how soft my skin was after I used this even after the first application. I have used it once a week for three weeks so far and plan to use it once a week indefinitely. My skin is incredibly smooth and soft after I rinse it off. I feel like my skin is much more radiant as well. There is some mild tingling while it is on but nothing too uncomfortable. This is a must have!

I love the way my skin looks and feels after using this exfoliator. Not only is it soft and glowy, but any current breakouts I might have are diminished or gone by the next day after using. My only complaint is that the smell is so unbelievably unpleasant

After the first treatment, my skin felt so soft and smooth and hydrated! My pores are less noticeable. I can't wait to see the results after using this for a few weeks. The consistency is more gel like than cream.
This is great! Powerful, but great! I would recommend this for sure. I use this once a week to truly resurface my skin. Feels great and remember, only 10 minutes is all you need.
I used this for a month now very recent. The more I use it the more I like.

I love this product! Once a week, at night, I leave it on for ten minutes, wash it off and then apply toner, serum and my night time moisturizer or mask and I wake up to smooth, soft, poreless, skin. It helps with fine lines too. :+1:
Changed the texture of my skin in one use! After two uses I am extremely impressed! Cant wait to try round 3 and see the difference!

This product is such a pretty color. There is no scent and a little goes a long way. I love the way my skin looks right after I wash it off. The result is always bright clean skin ready. I use it about once a week.
Can tell an instant difference it's like a dupe for the Paula's choice 10 minute mask but cheaper and more fun.
First time trying this product! I used it once so far I'm liking it!

I was a little hesitant to try this AHA BHA PHA LHA 35 Peel. Those are a lot of different acids at one time. I don't have sensitive skin, so I figured the outcome wouldn't be bad if something went wrong. But I was extremely happy with the results. My skin had never felt so smooth or looked so new. I mean baby butt smooth and new.
This spot cream didn't irritate or dry out my skin even like most spot creams do
Mask is really nice! Didn't burn at all and when I took it off, my skin was so soft! Will definitely be adding this to my weekly routine!

I really liked this product because not only is it gentle but it doesn't feel harsh on the skin and it is also light weight so I don't feel it too heavy on the skin when it's drying. I also love how it has little to no scent and I love that it's compatible for sensitive/oily skin

If you guys have ever used the Ordinary red peel, this is kind of similar. The only difference is that this is way way way more gentle. Yes it is tingly but it's not unbearable. I'm excited to see how my skin improves!
Great for pigmentation reduction and skin rejuvination. Love it as it leaves skin so smooth and soft. Will purchase this product again and again....
This peel seems to be a gentle yet effective exfoliant. I Can feel it tingle and can see nice smooth skin after use, but even my sensitive skin seems to handle it well.
I've used this product once since I bought it during the initial release. My face felt so soft and smooth.
I've used this once since I purchased it during the last sale and it's so good.y skin felt so smooth and soft!
I love this peel. There is a small tingling sensation (which I'm totally into) and doesn't leave my skin dried or sensitive. I will be continuing to use this!
Im starting to notice a difference in my skin! I was reluctant to try it but im glad that i did
This is my life changer cream! Its's work like magic in 10 mins!! My skin become suer smooth and fine texture! I got lot of compliments and my skin turned out like glass!! I highly recommended!!

I used the peel for the 1st time and I can't believe how soft my skin felt. I have sensitive skin, but I did not have any reactions! And the visible pores on and around my nose appears "shallower" and smaller in size. It's difficult to explain but I'm simply loving the results! After many years of Hawaiian sunshine, and now at 60 years old, I didn't think anything would help my skin. Just love Cosrx! :pray:

I bought this product cause I breakout sometimes and also want to smooth out my pores and skin texture. This peel did not sting but I will need to use it more to see if it provides actual results for me.

Love this product. It doesn't burn as much as some other similar products I've tried. My skin instantly looks refreshed and more glowing after I've used this. I use it a few times a week to keep my skin looking tip top.
This peel works great! My skin felt so clean after the first use. It really seems to work exactly as described.
Can definitely feel the tingle. Have only used twice but like it so far.
Literally after one use- my face texture has smoothed. I am so in love with every single product that I have tried.

I used this for the first time last night. Mild tingling upon application but no burning or irritation. Upon removal I did not have any skin redness. I used the peptide serum, snail mucin and hyaluronic acid lotion afterwards and woke up with smooth gorgeous skin. My t zone definitely looks clearer and my pores look tighter already!

I just tried once and it's amazing! Very gentle to my sensitive skin and yet effectively brightens and softly peels the dead cells! Love this product! I will update more after I have been using for atleast a month.
This cream work like magic!!! In 10 mins my skin turned out so smooth like silk. I get lot of compliments!!! Love it !!!!

avis.titre: Good but have only used it 1x so far
avis.texte: Seems nice. Doesn't make my face sting a bunch, but feels nice and exfoliating.
No joke after 1 use my skin was noticeably brighter and softer for sure
Made my skin feel so smooth. I only used it one time cause directions say use once a week. So I will update my review later with more detailed results. I like so far.

This goes on much easier than the comparable The Ordinary Product. I just used last night for the first time and am pleased that my skin does not feel tight but instead smooth. I feel it made a difference in the texture of my skin after one use!
